title: Crashing when clicking on GPUParticle3D and Sky resource in Environment.
body:
### Tested versions

Engine version: Godot Engine v4.6.3.stable.official (7d41c59c457bd5a245092b4e7eb2d833e3b3f8c3)


### System information

Godot v4.6.2.stable - Linux Mint 22.3 (Zena) on X11 - X11 display driver, Multi-window, 1 monitor - Vulkan (Forward+) - dedicated NVIDIA GeForce RTX 3050 Laptop GPU - AMD Ryzen 7 4800H with Radeon Graphics (16 threads) - 15.04 GiB memory

### Issue description

Godot crashes when clicking on GPUParticle3D node
Also crashes when I add a Sky resource into the environment.
